annotations.title: Severe thunderstorm outlook for a US location

description: Severe thunderstorm outlook for a US location — NOAA Storm Prediction Center day 1-3 convective outlook for a point in the contiguous US: risk category (general thunder, marginal, slight, enhanced, moderate, high = level 0-5), tornado, wind and hail probabilities within 25 miles with significant-severe flags (day 1-2), any-severe probability (day 3), valid and issue times, highest risk and a one-line summary. Use lat/lon or place. Source NOAA/NWS SPC (public domain). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

place.description: optional instead of lat/lon, e.g. Oklahoma City

name: weather_severe_outlook
